coverage.command: npx --no-install c8 --reporter=json --report-dir {outputDir}/cov --include 'modules/**' --include 'lib/**' --include server.mjs --include config.mjs node scripts/run-tests.mjs --test-reporter=dot

complexity.command: npx --no-install eslint --config config/quality/eslint.complexity.mjs --format json --output-file {outputDir}/eslint.json modules lib server.mjs config.mjs

dry.command: npx --no-install jscpd --reporters json --output {outputDir}/jscpd modules lib server.mjs config.mjs
